newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 14 muni issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 14 muni issues for insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said Wednesday it qualified for bond insurance the following 14 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale:
--Noblesville Economic Development Corp, Ind., $2.8 million bonds, by direct purchase.
--St Clair County Building Authority, Mich., $11 million GOs.
--Sterling Heights, Mich., Building Authority $1.8 million issue.
--Briarcliff Manor, N.Y., $4.101 million public improvement bonds.
--Austin Independent School District, Texas, $7.87 million bonds.
MBIA said it qualified Wisconin's $30 million GOs for secondary market insurance.
And it said it qualified South Bend Central School District, Ind.'s $43.2 million offering, set for sale Thursday, for insurance.
